parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system login user huawei123 class su.template: set system login user [parameter1] class [parameter2] authentication plain-text-password [parameter3]
set system login user huawei123 class su.command: set system login user huawei123 class super-user authentication plain-text-password $1c$%L%X:Jn3hY$5^%T5I\4HG>j|i~s,{.@FpH*2XGM\R;7#$\"i!L0$
set system login user huawei123 class su.explanation: 配置系统登录用户及其认证方式。

set system services aaa-authentication d.command: set system services aaa-authentication default local
set system services aaa-authentication d.explanation: 配置AAA认证默认使用本地认证。

set system services aaa-authorization ex.command: set system services aaa-authorization exec local
set system services aaa-authorization ex.explanation: 配置AAA授权执行使用本地授权。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:db8:4::1/64
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及子网前缀长度。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 enable
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family inet6 enable

parameters.name: unit
